messages:
alex: FYI I'm kicking off a config-only rollout for tenant queueing + softpin. 10% canary -> 50% over a 45m change window. deploy-bot will post status.
deploy-bot: deployctl: started rollout id=cfg-roll-2026-03-21-queue-softpin canary=10% change_window=45m
tara: quick ask — what's the explicit fallback/rollback condition here? want to make sure on-call knows triggers.
sam: fallback: if 95th latency > 1200ms for 5m OR error-rate increase +30% over baseline in same interval, we'll unpin canary and revert to previous config. ops-bot will notify.
ryan: adding: also if KV cache pressure > 80% for 10m we abort. that's been a pain point in prior queue tweaks.
maria: config snippet I'm rolling (YAML):
```
queue:
  tenant_floor: 5
  softpin_enabled: true
  softpin_decay: 120s
  max_inflight_per_tenant: 50
  routing_policy: prefer-low-latency
batching:
  target_batch_ms: 20
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 15000
  token_generation_timeout_ms: 12000
```
alex: I'm tagging @oncall (tara) — change window 17:10-17:55 UTC. If anything odd during canary ping here + escalate to eng-sre.
tara: Received. I'll watch dashboards and set a short-term alert rule: name=cfg-roll-queue-softpin-95p threshold=1.2s duration=5m. Also I set a temp mute for noisy infra alerts.
ryan: sanity-check commands:
- Check status: `deployctl status cfg-roll-2026-03-21-queue-softpin`
- Quick rollback: `deployctl rollback cfg-roll-2026-03-21-queue-softpin --to=previous`
sam: Suggest we pin model routing for the canary group to stable variant to avoid model churn during this config test.
maria: done — canary routing pinned to model:v1.3-stable for the 10% cohort.
deploy-bot: rollout update: canary=10% -> 25% after 15m successful health checks. id=cfg-roll-2026-03-21-queue-softpin
alex: good. If at 25% we see any 95p spikes, we stop the ramp and unpin. Otherwise proceed to 50% at +30m.
tara: If rollback is needed, I'll run the rollback command and open a short incident thread with playbook and TL;DR for product. :thumbsup:
